operations.content: Travel Content Factory: start.sh copies ROOT .env → backend/.env on every start. ALWAYS add API keys (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, ABACUS_AI_API_KEY, etc.) to the ROOT .env at /Users/dmitrypotekhin/travel-content-factory/.env, NEVER to backend/.env — it gets overwritten by the startup script.

Travel Content Factory now has Abacus AI image generation: backend/services/abacus.py (AbacusImageClient), backend/routers/images.py (/api/images/*), frontend Image Factory tab + Content Factory button + render cover checkbox. API: routellm.abacus.ai/v1/chat/completions, model: flux2_pro. Credits exhausted shows as 400 with body {"success":false,"error":"You have no remaining credits to use the LLM apis."}.
